description: Differential oracle for sage.rings.real_mpfr and sage.rings.complex_mpfr: arithmetic, directed rounding modes, exact/simplest/nearby rational conversion, floating-point introspection (ulp, fp_rank, sign_mantissa_exponent), the branch cuts of sqrt/log/arccos/arcsin/arctan/arctanh/arccosh, and the transcendental and special functions. Every argument is an INDEX into the REAL_VALUES / COMPLEX_VALUES operand tables, which are listed in the same order in tests/property/python/areas/mpfr.py and tests/property/typescript/areas/mpfr.ts.
